owner_decision: Owner: 'áp dụng bộ harness mới xóa sạch bộ harness cũ hiện tại' — the new harness is the simplified MCP architecture; the persistent MCP broker package is removed entirely. Hosts without a binary on the machine are skipped ('không có host nào thì bỏ qua thôi').
removed_surfaces: packages/mcp-guardian/ (entire package: broker SQLite/WAL state, durable leases, token ACL, lease state machine, host adapters, projection, reconnect/recreate, HTTP bridge, X11/EWMH placement, McpHttpBroker, tests, bin/connect)
automation/mcp-certify.mjs (old live certification importing broker dist)
automation/dsh-browser-server.mjs (shared Playwright HTTP daemon behind registry httpEndpoint)
reason: The broker had no production caller outside its own tests and imposed broker/lease/HTTP layers on plain MCP. Standard MCP must be host-native -> pinned provider -> stdio. The kernel focus guardian (packages/kernel/src/runner/mcp-guardian.mjs) is the single canonical guardian for interactive GUI MCP. Shared HTTP is explicit opt-in only and never a default.
replacement: Canonical simplified path: standard MCP direct stdio (pinned registry versions); interactive GUI MCP guardian-wrapped by mcp-config.ts; live host verification via automation/verify-windows-hosts.mjs (npm run verify:windows-hosts, Windows-local, never CI); audit automation/mcp-no-bypass-audit.mjs reworked to the new boundary.
recovery: git history (commit before this tombstone) restores the broker package, CLI command, and scripts if the owner ever re-approves persistent MCP sessions.
